q: You picked 'Add Lotus Marsh and Thunder Crag', but your note says 'Add all 4'. Which do you mean?
ctx: All 4 = Lotus Marsh, Thunder Crag, Azure Beast Ravine, Tribulation Peak, each with 1 NPC and new buildings. 11 islands total; about 25 art pieces per new island (~100 for 4, ~50 for 2). Two would use the empty bottom slots; the other two need new positions.
o: Only Lotus Marsh and Thunder Crag

q: Your fixed unlock order is Mine, Fishing, Farm, Grove, Volcano, then Celestial. Where do the new islands go?
ctx: Celestial stays last (it holds the Heavenly Gate ending).
o: After Volcano, before Celestial: ...Volcano, Lotus Marsh, Thunder Crag, Beast Ravine, Tribulation Peak, Celestial
Mixed in by difficulty (e.g. Lotus Marsh after Fishing, Thunder Crag after Mine)
